name: Hot Taco Dip
description: A warm, layered taco dip featuring seasoned ground beef, sour cream, and melted cheddar cheese, served with tortilla chips.
recipeIngredient: 1 package Old El Paso taco seasoning mix

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with chopped onion in a frying pan; drain excess fat.
Add taco seasoning mix to the browned hamburger and prepare according to package directions.
In a 13x9x2 inch baking dish, spread the prepared hamburger mixture evenly across the bottom.
Sprinkle the chopped green peppers on top of the hamburger layer.
Mix together the sour cream and cream cheese (if using) until smooth.
Spread the sour cream mixture over the top of the green peppers.
Spread a layer of mild salsa over the sour cream layer.
Top with a layer of grated cheddar cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F until heated through.
Serve hot with tortilla chips.

keywords: hot taco dip, taco dip, Mexican appetizer, cheesy dip

_similar.name: Taco Ring
_similar.description: A savory taco-flavored ring made with crescent rolls, ground beef, and cheese, served with salsa and fresh toppings.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry the hamburger and let it cool.
Add ¼ cup water and taco seasoning mix to the fried hamburger.
Lay the crescent roll dough on the outside edge of a 15-inch pizza-style pan, forming a circle with the pointed edge out.
Scoop the hamburger mixture onto the dough, leaving a 5-inch wide circle in the center.
Add shredded cheese on top of the hamburger mixture.
Bring the pointed edge of the pastry over the beef mixture and press to seal.
Bake for approximately 16 minutes or as per the directions on the pastry package until golden brown.
Let cool slightly before serving.
To serve, remove the top from the green pepper and scoop out the insides. Place salsa inside the green pepper.
Place the green pepper in the middle of the ring along with shredded lettuce and tomato. Serve with sour cream.

_similar.keywords: taco ring, crescent roll recipe, taco bake, Mexican-inspired

_similar.name: Taco Twist Bake
_similar.description: A hearty taco-flavored pasta bake with ground beef, spaghetti sauce, and melted cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start water to cook for pasta.
In a frying pan, brown the ground beef with the onions until the meat is no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Add mushrooms, taco seasoning, and water. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add spaghetti sauce, salsa, and green pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes more.
Cook the spiral pasta, then rinse and drain.
Combine pasta with sour cream.
Pour the pasta mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish or square baking dish.
Sprinkle with approximately half of the shredded cheddar cheese.
Cover with the meat mixture and bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: taco pasta bake, ground beef recipe, cheesy casserole

_similar.name: Nacho Dip
_similar.description: A creamy and flavorful dip made with cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning, topped with salsa, cheese, and chopped vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning mix until smooth.
Spread the mixture in a large glass pan.
Spread salsa sauce over the cream cheese layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the salsa layer.
Add chopped red pepper, green pepper, and tomato on top.
Serve with baked nacho chips.

_similar.keywords: nacho dip, creamy dip, taco seasoning, salsa dip

_similar.name: Nacho Fiesta Dip
_similar.description: A layered dip featuring cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: Large bag tortilla chips for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning together in a blender until well combined.
Place the mixture in a large bowl lined with Saran Wrap and refrigerate covered for 1 hour.
Remove the dip from the bowl by tipping it onto a platter or large plate and peeling off the Saran Wrap.
Cover the dip with shredded lettuce, then diced tomatoes, and finally grated cheddar cheese.
Surround with tortilla chips and serve.

_similar.keywords: layered dip, nacho fiesta, taco seasoning, cheesy dip

_similar.name: Taco Salad
_similar.description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, crunchy taco chips, and cheddar cheese, all tossed in Catalina dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook ground beef until crumbly, drain off fat, and season with taco seasoning mix.
Refrigerate the cooked beef until ready to use.
Toss together the cooled beef, chopped lettuce, crushed taco chips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix in Catalina dressing until well coated.
Carefully add in chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: taco salad, ground beef, taco chips, cheddar cheese
